usage: As an adjective, 清潔 describes something that is clean or tidy.
As a noun, 清潔 can refer to the act or process of cleaning.
You can use 清潔 to talk about personal hygiene or the cleanliness of a place.
In sentences, 清潔 often appears before the noun it describes, like 清潔嘅屋企 (clean house).
The word is commonly used in daily life when discussing cleaning chores or hygiene.
